name: SM_Prop_Candle_Holder_01
families: candle on a holder (integrator light sources)
supersedes: Stonebrook/SM_Candle_Iron_01 (same mesh as SM_Candle_Iron_PR under the name the integrator asked for)
dresses: tallow candle on a forged iron pricket stick, 0.2 x 0.45 m (identical to SM_Candle_Iron_PR)

emissive.type: flame, done in engine (no flame mesh in the FBX)
emissive.note: point light 2 cm above the wick, soft radius 1 cm, slow flicker 5-10 percent; slot MI_Prop_Candle_Holder_01_Wax is kind subsurface (the wax near the flame glows by scattering; no emissive mask)

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2, three review rounds. Last look faults little: the pricket stick is a clean lathe (hammer texture only in the normal), the puddle in the pan is thin, the wick is a plain bent tube. Wax needs the subsurface slot honoured in engine or it reads as chalk.
